description: Starts an audio generation on the signed-in aicut account (speech, music, a song with vocals or a sound effect, chosen by `model`) and returns its job id at once; it does NOT wait for the audio. WHEN: the user asks for one of those. Call `list_models` with `type: "audio"` first: each model takes DIFFERENT arguments (its `parameters`; `get_recipe` `starter-audio` maps them), and a field it does not publish is rejected, not ignored. A speech `voice` id comes from `list_voices`. HOW IT SOUNDS: the knobs marked 'Result only' come at no extra price and need no re-quote; only those a model publishes in `parameters` are accepted. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card: do not call `show_generation` for this job. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), again at once while `terminal: false`, then one short line; no `get_*` polling, timers, background shells or narrating the wait. No card? Give the user the `url`. TIMING: audio usually finishes in under a minute (often 10 seconds for a short effect) and can take up to about 4 minutes for a long script. Do not spawn timers or background shells. COST: speech, music and sound effects are priced on a RATE (per character, minute, second: `pricing_rates`), a song per call. Never multiply it yourself: pass `estimate_only: true` with the exact settings whenever the user has not agreed to the cost. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).

custom_mode.description: Song: true = Lyrics mode (needs `title`; takes `lyrics`, `vocal_gender`, `duration_seconds`); omit = Quick (needs `prompt`).

duration.description: Sound-effect length in seconds within the model's `min`/`max`; billed per second. An omitted length is quoted at a fallback price. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

duration_seconds.description: Song, Lyrics mode: whole seconds. Result only.

estimate_only.description: Price only; creates nothing. The only accurate audio quote.

force_instrumental.description: Music: no vocals. Result only, not price.

length_ms.description: Music length in whole milliseconds within the model's `min`/`max`; billed per started minute. An omitted length is quoted at a fallback price. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

loop.description: Sound effects: loop seamlessly. Result only, not price.

lyrics.description: Song, Lyrics mode: words to sing; omit to have them written.

model.description: Model id exactly as `list_models` returns it (`elevenlabs-tts-v2` speech, `elevenlabs-music` music, `suno-v6` song, `elevenlabs-sfx` sound effect); it decides which other arguments apply. Use the one the user asked for.

prompt.description: Music: the track (mood, instruments, tempo). Song: the Quick-mode idea.

prompt_influence.description: Sound effects: how literally to follow the text (the model's `min`/`max`). Result only, not price.

similarity_boost.description: Speech, `elevenlabs-tts-v2` and `-v4` only: how closely the delivery sticks to the voice. Result only.

speed.description: Speech, `elevenlabs-tts-v2` only: speaking rate, 1 is normal. Result only.

stability.description: Speech: how steady the delivery is (lower more expressive, higher flatter). Result only, not price.

style.description: Speech, `elevenlabs-tts-v2` only: how far the speaker's own style is exaggerated. Result only.

text.description: Speech: the exact words to speak (priced PER CHARACTER: never padded or shortened to change the price). Sound effect: a description of the sound. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

title.description: Song: the title (required in Lyrics mode).

vocal_gender.description: Song, Lyrics mode: singer voice (a preference).

voice.description: Required by speech models. Get it from `list_voices` with `provider: 'elevenlabs', usable_for: 'audio', limit: 100` (21 stock voices; without `limit` you see 20 and cannot tell). The user picks it from `preview_url` links BEFORE this call. Never invent one: it fails AFTER the job exists and is charged. Cloned and custom voices work on `generate_fake_text_video` and `generate_image_story`, not here.
